title: Price rows for one day
statementMd:
Show the closing price of every ticker on 2024-03-15.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `close`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, close FROM prices WHERE trade_date = '2024-03-15';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.

expected.query: SELECT symbol, close FROM prices WHERE trade_date = '2024-03-15';
